# PHASE-008 - Integrate advanced frozen context and memory boundaries

| Field | Value |

| Phase status | `planned` |
| Depends on | PHASE-007 |

## Objective

Use advanced knowledge without changing Task or memory ownership.

## Scope

- Versioned immutable packets
- Manager-controlled reassessment
- Mixed retrieval preservation

## Entry conditions

- Advanced operations and guard decisions expose exact versioned inputs.

## Exit criteria

- Frozen advanced packets remain identical across independent solvers.
- New ontology state cannot silently enter active context or rewrite memory.

## Risks

- Live operational checks and frozen solver knowledge have different freshness rules.

## TASK-039 - Add advanced immutable ontology packets

Extend ontology packet building/search with explicit advanced schema support and selected rules, shapes, proof facts, graph and semantic retrieval context.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-014, TASK-021, TASK-038 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- No new Task schema or writer route; do not freeze unrelated live source state.

### Acceptance criteria

- Existing artifact/hash interfaces and byte/reference limits are retained; old readers reject unsupported advanced versions.
- Every queued initial solver receives identical frozen bytes; queries cannot import live facts, proposals, embeddings or sibling candidates.

### Planned verification

- Run packet selection, truncation/oversize, source-version and legacy-reader fixtures.
- Compare exact packet references across independent and queued assignment scenarios.

## TASK-040 - Integrate manager-controlled advanced change assessment

Report material rule, inference, accepted-proposal or source changes through existing reassessment/input/review gates.

| Dependencies | TASK-039, TASK-027 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A new inference result is evidence for assessment, not permission to replace context.

### Acceptance criteria

- A changed ontology does not mutate solver packets; current guards reject stale pending actions separately.
- The current manager owns reconciliation and revised inputs and retains all required team/review gates.

### Planned verification

- Publish a new concept/rule between solver dispatches and verify it stays excluded.
- Exercise material change, stopped-owner reconciliation, exact new references and repeated review gates.

## TASK-041 - Verify mixed advanced retrieval preserves memory

Extend derived mixed-query attribution and integration tests through installed memory read interfaces, preserving canonical memory and independent settings.

| Dependencies | TASK-040, TASK-026 |
| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- Memory-side mutations require their own actual authorization; ontology grants cannot substitute.

### Acceptance criteria

- Definitions, inferences, proposals and historical evidence retain distinct identity/source types.
- Ontology operations leave memory v1 records, corpus, capture/backend choices and frozen memory unchanged; new links remain derived/versioned.

### Planned verification

- Hash memory schema/corpus/config before and after inference, proposal publication, browser editing and RDF interchange.
- Test excluded sources, frozen queries and reciprocal independent publication on isolated fixtures.
